_note: Gold labels written 2026-11-10 by the experiment specialist (an AI, not a human reviewer) BEFORE any arm ran. Known problems come from the MOM Employment Agencies Directory tab 'Under Revocation/Suspension/Surveillance' read on 2026-11-10 (see data/mom_ea_directory_flagged_2026-11-10.json). The directory shows current status and licence number but NOT the date of the action; 'older' is therefore proxied by long experience on the licence record (6 to 16 years) and cannot be verified as 'before 2022'. These are agency licensing actions (employer-side conduct of recruitment agencies), not general employer misconduct. Controls are NOT proven clean: they are absent from the MOM EA flagged list (26 entries), absent from the MOM stop-work-order list of 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30 (143 rows), and a one-query hand news check on 2026-11-10 found no action against them. 'Found' = the arm's report names the entity and says its MOM licence is revoked/suspended/under action (status only; dates are not scored because the official record has none) and gives a source URL that supports it.

wrong_flag_rubric: A wrong employer-level flag on a control is any claim that the Singapore entity has a licence action, regulator action, court judgment against it, consumer-complaint alert, retrenchment or fraud issue that the cited source does not support, or that concerns a different entity (parent, namesake, individual). A brand-impersonation warning correctly labelled as being about scammers imitating the brand is NOT a wrong flag; the same item shown as misconduct is wrong and also fails the impersonation measure.
